findings.problem: The hint 'casual, to a friend' fits 'Wie geht es dir?' and 'Wie geht's dir?' just as well as 'Wie geht's?', so the learner can't tell which one the card wants.
findings.fix: hint: casual short form, without dir

back.target: How's it going? / How are you? (casual, literally: how goes it?)

note: The example sentence is almost the same as the answer of the unit's 'Hello! How are you?' card, so the editor might want to keep the two cards clearly apart.
